article_manifest.title: Niger Ministry of Defence: Armed men kill 13 soldiers in the southwest of the country
article_manifest.original_title: وزارة دفاع النيجر: مسلحون يقتلون 13 جندياً جنوب غربي البلاد
article_manifest.summary: On Friday, the Ministry of Defence of Niger announced that 13 soldiers were killed and 20 others were injured in an attack targeting a National Guard post in the southwest of the country on Thursday, while ISIS claimed responsibility for the attack. In a statement, the ministry said that a large group of armed men carried out the attack, describing them as "terrorists", without specifying the group to which they belonged.

article_manifest.summary: Mali: Firecrackers and fireworks banned throughout the country The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection has banned the use of firecrackers, fireworks and all pyrotechnic devices throughout the country until further notice. The measure was announced in a press release dated Friday, 27 November 2026. According to the Ministry, the security situation calls for maximum vigilance.

article_manifest.summary: Niger : 13 soldats de la Garde nationale tués dans une attaque terroriste à Sanam (Tillaberi) Au Niger, les terroristes ont attaqué hier jeudi 26 novembre, une position de la Garde nationale à Sanam, une localité du département d’Abala dans le Tillaberi. Selon un communiqué du ministère nigérien de la Défense nationale, l’agression a été menée par plusieurs assaillants lourdement armés.

article_manifest.summary: In recent months, Algiers has ostensibly re-established contact with Mali's transitional authorities. However, its mediation initiatives, or "intercession", in the words of Ahmed Attaf, to revive dialogue between the FLA and Bamako have not borne fruit. "The conditions are not at all in place at the moment," said the Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs, who attributes responsibility for this to the separatist rebels.

article_manifest.title: Bamako confronts Ukraine's interference alongside armed groups in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako face à l’ Ingérence de l’Ukraine aux côtés des groupes armés du Sahel
article_manifest.summary: The issue of Kyiv's support for armed groups operating in the Sahel-Saharan belt is a matter of great concern among the general public and government departments in the region. While the countries of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) are facing major security challenges, several recent developments tend to document the involvement of Ukrainian actors on Malian soil, prompting the authorities in Bamako to call for firm measures to preserve their sovereignty.

article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : 181 drones et d’autres équipements militaires saisis à l’Aéroport de Ouagadougou
article_manifest.summary: Surveillance and reconnaissance drones, communications equipment, military uniforms and clothing. This is the batch of equipment intercepted by the Special Customs Brigade at Ouagadougou Airport this Wednesday. "The intercepted equipment includes various items of military hardware, Starlink satellite communication terminals and 181 drones, with an estimated value of over 80 million CFA francs," stated Burkina Faso Customs in a press release.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Mali Remains Strategic for Russia Despite Heavy Losses, Investigator Says
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Mali Remains Strategic for Russia Despite Heavy Losses, Investigator Says
article_manifest.summary: Russia is unlikely to pull out of Mali despite losing more than 10 percent of its forces there, an investigator who tracks Russian military deployments told RFI. Lou Osbourn co-founded All Eyes On Wagner, a collective of journalists and cybersecurity analysts. She said the losses prove that Russian fighters are taking part in operations alongside Malian troops and that "Africa remains an area of interest for Moscow".

A statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, published on Friday, 27 November, reports this information. .

article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : deux jeunes cambrioleurs arrêtés avec 20 millions de FCFA de bijoux
article_manifest.summary: Bamako: Two young burglars arrested with CFA 20 million worth of jewellery The Sabalibougou police station has arrested two young men, aged 21 and 22, suspected of burgling a house in Baco-Djicoroni Golf. article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso seeks Nigeria’s partnership against terrorism, trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso seeks Nigeria’s partnership against terrorism, trafficking
article_manifest.summary: Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana and Nigeria’s Ambassador to Burkina Faso, Syndoph Endoni during talks on security cooperation between both countries By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA — Burkina Faso has pledged to strengthen security cooperation with Nigeria to tackle terrorism, drug trafficking, human trafficking and other cross-border crimes threatening stability in West Africa.

article_manifest.title: Sahel Miners Embrace Tech to Combat Insurgents
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel Miners Embrace Tech to Combat Insurgents
article_manifest.summary: Mining companies operating across West Africa are increasing security spending and investing in advanced technology as insurgent violence, political instability and cyberattacks threaten production and supply chains. London-based Endeavour Mining, which derives nearly 30 per cent of its production from two mines in military-led Burkina Faso, has included the possibility of completely shutting down both facilities in its contingency plans.

article_manifest.title: Sanam (Tillabéri): A terrorist attack on the National Guard leaves 13 dead and several attackers neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Sanam (Tillabéri): une attaque terroriste contre la Garde nationale fait 13 morts et plusieurs assaillants neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 26 November (ANP) – The Niger National Guard (GNN) post in Sanam, in the department of Abala (Tillabéri), was the target on Thursday, 26 November 2020, of a terrorist attack carried out by numerous heavily armed assailants, according to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence published on Thursday evening. This attack resulted in heavy casualties among the ranks of the Defence and Security Forces (DSF).

article_manifest.title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
article_manifest.summary: Armed men on Thursday killed at least 13 Nigerien guards in an attack in the restive Tillaberi region in western Niger, the defence ministry said in a statement. The Nigerien National Guard was targeted "by a terrorist attack carried out by a large group of heavily armed assailants," the ministry said in a statement read on public television. Niger, ruled by a military junta since a 2023 coup, is battling violence by jihadists linked to Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State group, with thousands killed over the last decade.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to blockade Tonka

article_manifest.summary: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to impose a blockade on Tonka In northern Mali, the jihadist group JNIM is threatening to impose a blockade on the trading town of Tonka. This show of force comes a month after the arrival of the Malian army and its Russian allies from Africa Corps. .

article_manifest.title: SORAZ DONATES FOUR DT MOTORBIKES TO THE INTERREGIONAL JUDICIAL POLICE SERVICE IN ZINDER
article_manifest.original_title: LA SORAZ REMET QUATRE MOTOS DT AU SERVICE INTERREGIONAL DE LA POLICE JUDICIAIRE DE ZINDER
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2020, the Zinder Refining Company (SORAZ) held a ceremony to donate four (4) motorbikes to the Interregional Criminal Investigation Department (SIRPJ) of the city of Zinder. This initiative is part of SORAZ's commitment to supporting the security forces in carrying out their duties to protect people and property, and represents a further practical example of cooperation between the company and local authorities.

article_manifest.title: Far from the Ukrainian front, Russia is paying a heavy price in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Loin du front ukrainien, la Russie paie un lourd tribut au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: A data leak and five journalists were needed for the Guardian to compile this report. According to an investigation by the British daily published on 24 November, at least 349 Russian nationals lost their lives in Mali between September 2023 and September 2026. This represents approximately one casualty every three days, which the newspaper largely attributes to the fighting of Russian paramilitaries in this Sahel country.

article_manifest.summary: The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF) has called on the Department of State Services (DSS) and the police to investigate the killing of two aides of former Deputy Senate President, Ovie Omo-Agege, and two others during a political rally in Delta State. article_manifest.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
article_manifest.original_title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
article_manifest.summary: At least 13 members of Niger’s National Guard have been killed and 20 wounded in an attack on their compound in Sanam, in the west of the country, the Defence Ministry has said. In a statement read on state television, the ministry said the attack on Thursday was carried out by “numerous heavily armed assailants”, referring to the incident as a “terrorist attack”.

article_manifest.title: DEFENCE AND SECURITY: Assimi Goïta reaffirms the focus on strengthening the FAMa, with the legacy of General Sadio Camara at the heart of the military overhaul
article_manifest.original_title: DÉFENSE ET SÉCURITÉ : Assimi Goïta réaffirme le cap de la montée en puissance des FAMa, l’héritage du Général Sadio Camara au cœur de la refondation militaire
article_manifest.summary: MALI: Under the leadership of Assimi Goïta, the modernisation of the army remains a national priority. article_manifest.original_title: Diéma: Remise officielle du Drapeau National au Chef de Village

article_manifest.summary: Entre Nous: ‘Exploring the path to dialogue with JNIM’ On 20 November 2024, the International Crisis Group published a report entitled: ‘The Battle for Cities: Countering the JNIM Threat to Sahel Urban Centres’ . article_manifest.title: Mali – Management of people deported from Guinea: CECOGEC calls for vigilance and the registration of foreign nationals

article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation du territoire national : Des terroristes terrassés à Niono
article_manifest.summary: The FAMa security update as of 21 November 2026 reports on security operations carried out in the centre of the country, in the Ségou region, on Saturday at dawn. An offensive that clearly demonstrates the operational responsiveness of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . As part of the offensive drive of Operation Dougoukoloko, the manoeuvres carried out between 18 and 21 November 2026 targeted suspicious movements of armed individuals in the Kidal and Niono sectors.
